prosaic

Render and write selected artifacts to every selected supporting target

Commands:
  prosaic apply                 Render and write selected artifacts to every
                                selected supporting target             [default]
  prosaic import [path]         Import existing tool prose into neutral prosaic
                                source (inverse of apply)
  prosaic revert                Remove previously distributed tool-generated
                                files
  prosaic resolve <artifactId>  Resolve one artifact-target pair's execution
                                settings without writing any file
  prosaic inspect <artifactId>  Return full data for one discovered artifact
                                (identifier, type, frontmatter, body, bundle
                                root, resources) as JSON
  prosaic tools                 List neutral CLI tool manifests as JSON without
                                executing anything
  prosaic package               Package deployment commands (generic,
                                application-agnostic)

Options:
  --version  Show version number                                       [boolean]
  --targets  Target identifiers to distribute to (overrides config)      [array]
  --types    Artifact types to distribute (rule|skill|subagent|command)  [array]
  --source   Source-of-truth directory                                  [string]
  --lossy    Lossy-transform policy                   [choices: "warn", "error"]
  --color    Force colored output on, or off with --no-color (auto-detected by
             default)                                                  [boolean]
  --help     Show help                                                 [boolean]
  --dry-run                                           [boolean] [default: false]
